Third-party libraries committed to vendor/.
Most are header-only (just include the header); Clipper2 also ships
compiled translation units (see below). No package manager needed.

cpp-httplib v0.18.3
  Header: httplib/httplib.h
  Source: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib
  License: MIT

nlohmann/json v3.11.3
  Header: nlohmann/json.hpp
  Source: https://github.com/nlohmann/json
  License: MIT

clipper2 2.0.1 (commit f9c5eb6e14a59f6f5d65fbfb3564519a561cf4fd) — Boost Software License 1.0 — 2D polygon boolean (Intersect/Area); units compiled: clipper.engine.cpp
